title: DataFlowBench immutable benchmark freeze v1
description: A release-evidence manifest. Every path and digest is checked against a clean checkout before a claim may be published.

benchmark.description: The exact benchmark state the evidence was produced against.

claim.description: What this freeze asserts and over what partition: scope, tracks, score dimensions, exclusions, score tiers, and model profiles.

cases.description: Every selected case with its semantic metadata, case digest, and the digest of every fixture.

adapters.description: Each adapter's version, analyzer identity, configuration hash, and the single track, dimension, and profile its evidence belongs to.

reports.description: Each normalized report with its digest, selected case IDs, outcomes, and one retained raw-evidence digest per result.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of an artifact's bytes. The manifest digests, not revision equality, carry the byte-immutability guarantee for every referenced artifact.

fixture_revision.description: sha256:-prefixed corpus digest as emitted by the runners; it must match across every report in the freeze.

track.description: Semantic track (see the case schema). A report binds exactly one, and all of its selected cases must match it.

dimension.description: Score dimension. The same five values as track but a distinct axis: witness quality is a separate dimension that may consume a semantic-flow case without being pooled with that case's correctness result.

profile.description: Model profile (see the case schema). benchmark-controlled and tool-native results cannot be pooled.

score_tier.description: Score tier (see the case schema). Tiers have separate denominators and result sections and are never pooled.

outcome.description: Normalized outcome (see the result schema). inconclusive, unsupported, and runner-error remain evidence outcomes and are never converted into negatives.

revision.description: The Git commit of the evidence, not of the manifest — a commit cannot contain its own hash, so the manifest is committed on top of it. Validation accepts checkout HEAD or one of its ancestors.

release.description: The release name this freeze belongs to. Release and website scopes require a v-prefixed tag whose commit contains the frozen revision.

case_schema_version.description: Case schema version the frozen cases conform to.

result_schema_version.description: Normalized-result schema version the frozen reports conform to; a report at a different version is rejected.

fixture_revision.description: The single corpus fixture revision every frozen report must declare, recomputed from the manifest's own cases and fixtures at validation time; mixed revisions are rejected.

dirty.description: Clean-worktree assertion. A freeze cannot be created or validated from a dirty checkout.

scope.description: What the freeze is for. development is an internal checkpoint; release and website additionally require a v-prefixed release tag containing the frozen revision and reject placeholder adapter identities.

tracks.description: The semantic tracks this claim covers; tracks partition the claim and are never pooled.

dimensions.description: The score dimensions this claim covers; each keeps its own scorecard.

exclusions.description: Cases deliberately left out of the claim, published verbatim with their reasons on the generated result pages so an exclusion cannot be silent.

reason.description: Why the case is excluded; reproduced verbatim in the published artifacts.

score_tiers.description: The score tiers this claim covers.

model_profiles.description: The model profiles this claim covers; benchmark-controlled and tool-native results cannot be pooled.

path.description: Repository-relative path to one fixture file bound by this case.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of that fixture's bytes, re-verified against a clean checkout before any claim may be published.

id.description: The frozen case's id, matching the case file on disk.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the case JSON file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the case JSON bytes.

fixture_digests.description: One digest entry per file in the case's fixture_files.

track.description: The case's own track, restated in the manifest so stale or altered case metadata is detected.

score_tier.description: The case's own score tier, restated so drift from the case file is rejected.

model_profile.description: The case's own model profile; every case a report selects must match the report's profile.

template_id.description: The case's language-neutral template identity, restated for drift detection.

polarity.description: The case's polarity, restated for drift detection.

id.description: Manifest-local adapter key that frozen reports reference through report.adapter.

tool.description: The analyzer, matching the normalized report's tool.

tool_version.description: Pinned analyzer version, matching the report's tool_version; must be concrete on a release or website freeze.

build_identity.description: The analyzer build the run was pinned to, matching the report's tool_build_identity; must be concrete on a release or website freeze.

adapter_version.description: DataFlowBench adapter version, matching the report's adapter_version.

configuration_hash.description: SHA-256 over the adapter's committed configuration, matching the report's configuration_hash; identity drift between report and adapter entry is rejected.

track.description: The single semantic track this adapter's evidence belongs to.

dimension.description: The single score dimension this adapter's evidence belongs to.

model_profile.description: The single model profile this adapter's evidence belongs to.

outcome.description: The normalized outcome the report recorded, restated in the manifest so the frozen claim and the report cannot drift apart.

case_id.description: The case whose raw evidence this is; exactly one entry per result.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the retained raw artifact; must equal the result's raw_output.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw artifact's bytes. Validation also parses the artifact and rejects raw evidence declaring inconclusive, unsupported, or runner-error beneath a normalized report claiming a clean not-reached.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the normalized report; a freeze may not list the same report twice.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the normalized report's bytes.

normalized_report_sha256.description: The normalized report's digest, which must equal sha256; a mismatch is rejected as inconsistent normalized-report digests.

adapter.description: The id of the adapter entry in this manifest's adapters array that produced this report.

track.description: The single semantic track this report binds; all of its selected cases must match it.

dimension.description: The single score dimension this report binds; each scorecard covers exactly one report.

model_profile.description: The single model profile this report binds; all of its selected cases must match it.

case_ids.description: The exact set of cases this report covers; a duplicate or incomplete result set is rejected.

outcomes.description: One outcome record per selected case, mirroring the normalized report.

raw_evidence.description: One retained raw-evidence digest per result, so a reader can walk from any published number back to frozen bytes.
